about.text: (Tibetan dried cheese) is a Tibetan cheese and important within the cuisine of Tibet. Chura kampo is made from the curds that are left over from boiling buttermilk.

sources.text: Curds from boiled buttermilk, dried into hard chewy chunks; Wikipedia stub gives no times
